scope: why the client never starts sending moves

observation.move_packets: the dedicated server log only shows the bridge's forged ack lines ('on stale serverId 0 ... ack 1 gamestate 31'); the client itself never sends clc_move
observation.meaning: the client treats the connection as established but not in-game; it waits for a usable snapshot before it initialises the game and starts the command stream

deduction: the client drops the message before or during snapshot parsing. The likely gate is the reassembled message length/format (11338 bytes, 10 fragments) or a field check in CL_ParseSnapshot that the 2697 body cannot satisfy; either way the client never reaches 'in game'.
